topic: Denis Tassitano assume liderança da Swile Brasil Mundo Negro Brasil
insights: Denis Tassitano has been appointed as the new CEO of Swile Brasil, succeeding Júlio Britto.
Tassitano previously held a senior role at SAP, specifically as vice-president of SAP Concur for Latin America and the Caribbean.
Swile Brasil is experiencing significant growth, representing about 25% of the company's global business volume.
The company aims to expand its portfolio from corporate benefits to a digital wallet that includes various financial solutions for employees.
Tassitano's focus will be on enhancing the Travel & Expense services offered by Swile.

summary: Denis Tassitano has taken over as CEO of Swile Brasil, bringing extensive experience from SAP to lead the company's growth in the Travel & Expense sector. With a strong user base and a focus on expanding financial solutions, Swile is poised for significant development in the Brazilian market.
